name: 🎲 BRAINROT LOTTERY
desc:
🎲 Welcome to BRAINROT LOTTERY!

How to Play:
🔲 Select one of the four pads in front of the Brainrot!
✅ If your pad is selected, you win the Brainrot!
💸 The brainrots generate money!
⬆️ Upgrade your pedestal and unlock rare Brainrots!

👍 Like the game and join the group!
💻 Available on Desktop, Mobile, Tablet & Console!
